description: normalizedMutualInformation guard cases. Empty and ragged inputs that previously caused index-out-of-bounds crashes now return 0 (matching mutualInformation's sentinel). Pins the MX-Tidy fix (2026-06-05).

cases.name: empty_joint
cases.note: Empty slice: joint[0] access removed by guard.

cases.name: ragged_joint
cases.note: Ragged rows (lengths 2 and 1) return sentinel; marginals would be wrong.

cases.name: perfectly_correlated_2x2
cases.note: Valid input: NMI = 1 under perfect correlation. Existing behavior unchanged.

cases.name: independent_2x2
cases.note: Valid input: NMI = 0 under independence. Existing behavior unchanged.
